variety_description: High yielding, late maturity, tall, medium bold variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 1994 for planting in all over Bangladesh in Aman season. Tolerant to major leaf diseases and Tungro virus. Susceptible to lodging. Low protein content
